lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: transformations as functions taking points to points
lessonRef.title: Investigation or close reading: transformations as functions taking points to points

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows the kind of reasoning the investigation asks for.

items.prompt: Rotate (4, 1) by 90° counterclockwise about the origin.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Talk through what changes and what stays fixed before you answer.

items.prompt: A regular polygon has 3 sides. How many rotations about its centre, strictly between 0° and 360°, carry it onto itself, and what is the smallest such angle?

Triangle ABC has vertices A(1, 6) and B(6, -1). After a transformation the images are A′(-1, -6) and B′(-6, 1), and the triangle keeps its size and orientation sense. Which single rigid motion describes this?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Point P(7, -2) is translated by the rule (x, y) → (x + 4, y + 1). Give the image P′.
Reflect the point (-1, -4) across the x-axis. Give the image.
Rotate the point (12, -3) counterclockwise about the origin by 270°. Give the image.
A regular polygon has 8 sides. How many rotations about its centre, strictly between 0° and 360°, carry it onto itself, and what is the smallest such angle?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Write out the reasoning in full sentences. A correct answer with no justification does not count here.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC has vertices A(3, -1) and B(-1, -3). After a transformation the images are A′(-3, 1) and B′(1, 3), and the triangle keeps its size and orientation sense. Which single rigid motion describes this?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Point P(-2, -7) is translated by the rule (x, y) → (x + 4, y − 4). Give the image P′.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
